components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one purple action in an area.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #5b2acb; color: #fff; height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; font: 600 14px 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), scale 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #4c22af; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #2a1550; scale: 0.97; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1e72d8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Labelled field with a Control Edge border.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #9e8aac; border-radius: 9px; background: #fff; color: #24143b; font: 400 16px 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6b6276; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1e72d8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Wash, hairline, dot and word for every status.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 24px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid #bfe3d6; border-radius: 6px; background: #eef8f4; color: #0b6b55; font: 600 12px 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-badge-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: #12866a; }

components.name: Date Rail
components.description: Day and month tile that leads every event card.
components.css: .ds-rail { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 9px; background: #f0eafe; color: #2a1550; } .ds-rail b { font: 600 20px/1 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; } .ds-rail small { margin-top: 4px; font: 600 12px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: A student culture magazine, a polished ticket window and an operations desk sharing one purple-first system. Light-only, flat and hairline-led; motion is small and earned.
keyCharacteristics: Purple carries actions, current state and identity; status colours carry meaning and never decorate.
Two typefaces: Space Grotesk for h1/h2 and display, DM Sans for everything else.
Four named radii (6, 9, 14, 20px); no generic rounded-md/lg/xl.
Every surface is opaque; no gradients except the striped image placeholder.

rules.name: The Status-Only Rule
rules.body: Jade, ochre and crimson appear only with a status word or icon (StatusBadge, Notice), never as decoration or brand.

rules.name: The Hairline Default Rule
rules.body: Borders default to the hairline token; a stronger edge marks only something you type into or press.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Space Grotesk only on h1, h2 and font-display elements such as the date rail numerals; card titles stay DM Sans.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow at rest except something floating above the page.

dos: Do use the semantic utilities (bg-brand, text-ink-soft, border-line, rounded-card, max-w-page) for every colour, radius and width.
Do keep one purple primary action per area; use secondary or tertiary for the rest.
Do show every status through StatusBadge or Notice, with its word.
Do keep check-in, list rows, tab changes and payment results still; animate only menus, dialogs, phone sheets and newly issued tickets.
donts: Don't use raw palette classes (bg-neutral-900, text-purple-600) or hex values in components.
Don't use rounded-md, rounded-lg or rounded-xl; use the four named radii.
Don't add a dark mode, an icon library or a shadow at rest.
Don't use status colours or a society's own colours for buttons, payment or security cues.
